ja_pron: Shōjiki na tokoro, tori o ayatsutte sakana o toraseru no wa zankoku ni mieru kamoshiremasen.
native: To be honest, manipulating birds to catch fish can seem cruel.

en: Fishermen tie thin, hemp string around the birds' neck to prevent them from swallowing fish.
zh: 漁夫會在鳥的脖子上綁上細麻繩，防止牠們吞下魚。
ja: 漁師は鳥の首に細い麻の紐を結び、魚を飲み込まないようにしています。

local: He started fishing with his father, age 17.
ja_pron: Kare wa 17-sai no toki ni chichioya to issho ni ryo o hajimemashita.
native: He started fishing with his father, age 17.

zh: 如今，他是鵜鶘捕魚藝術中最著名的繼承人。

ja_pron: Genzai, kare wa ukai no gijutsu de mottomo yūmei na kōkeisha desu.
native: Today, he is the most well-known successor of the art of cornbread fishing.

en: Here we get another one, come on, get in there, get in there, kill a guy, get some more.
zh: 這裡我們又抓到一條，來吧，進去，進去，抓住一條，再多抓幾條。
ja: ここでまた一匹捕まえました。さあ、入って、入って、魚を捕まえて、もっと捕りましょう。
local: Here we get another one, come on, get in there, get in there, kill a guy, get some more.

native: Here we get another one, come on, get in there, get in there, kill a guy, get some more.

local: Can you catch me a fish?
ja_pron: Sakana o tsukamaete kuremasu ka?
native: Can you catch me a fish?

zh: 黃宗威這一代的大多數漁夫一生都住在船上。

ja_pron: Kō Sōi no sedai no hotondo no ryōshi wa, isshō o fune no ue de sugoshite kimashita.
native: Most fishermen of Huang Trongwee's generation have spent their lives living on boats.

zh: 他們的整個世界建立在這些鳥能提供的東西上，以及他們的眼睛，

ja: 漁師と鵜の関係はもはや単純ではありません。

zh: 像黃宗威這樣的漁夫早已離開船隻，定居下來，

ja_pron: Kō Sōi no yō na ryōshi wa sudeni fune o hanare, teijū shiteimasu,
native: fishermen like Huang Trongwee have long since moved out of their boats, and settled

local: in the residential area by the river banks.
ja_pron: Kawagishi no jūtaku-chi ni.
native: in the residential area by the river banks.

zh: 在這裡，他們仍然能繼續他們的捕魚習慣。

local: Here, they are still able to continue their fishing habits.
ja_pron: Koko de karera wa mada ryo no shūkan o tsuzukeru koto ga dekimasu.
native: Here, they are still able to continue their fishing habits.

ja: 彼女がしたいことはあなたについて話し、どんな方法でも良い手を作ることです。もしここで少し止められるなら、手の雑誌を手に加えて、あなたのキャラクターに渡してください。

en: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.
zh: 廣鼎海是黃同貴的二表兄弟。
ja: 広鼎海は黄同貴のいとこ（二親等）です。
local: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.
ja_pron: Kōtei Kai wa Kō Dōki no itoko (nishintō) desu.
native: Guangdings Hai is Huang Tonggui's second cousin.

en: From his mannerisms in attire, I feel that he is already worlds apart from the lifestyles
zh: 從他的穿著舉止來看，我覺得他已經與傳統漁夫的生活方式相去甚遠，
ja: 彼の服装や仕草から、彼はすでに伝統的な漁師の生活様式とは全く異なる世界にいると感じます。

zh: 傳統漁夫的生活方式。

zh: 養鵜鶘並非易事。
ja: 鵜を育てることは簡単なことではありません。
local: Raising the cormorants is not an easy undertaking.
ja_pron: U o sodateru koto wa kantan na koto de wa arimasen.
native: Raising the cormorants is not an easy undertaking.

en: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.
zh: 除了餵食，你還必須日復一日地訓練和照顧牠們。
ja: 餌を与えるだけでなく、日々訓練し世話をしなければなりません。
local: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.
ja_pron: Esa o ataeru dake de naku, hibi kunren shi sewa o shinakereba narimasen.
native: Other than feeding them, you have to train and care for them day after day.

en: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.
zh: 我很驚訝廣鼎海有九隻幼鳥。
ja: 広鼎海に9羽の雛がいるとは驚きました。
local: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.
ja_pron: Kōtei Kai ni kyū wa no hina ga iru to wa odorokimashita.
native: I was surprised that Guangdings Hai had nine chicks.

en: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.
zh: 我不相信他與鳥兒的關係僅僅是基於感情。
ja: 彼の鳥との関係が単に愛情だけで結ばれているとは思いません。
local: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.
ja_pron: Kare no tori to no kankei ga tan ni aijō dake de musubarete iru to wa omoimasen.
native: I don't believe that his relationship with the birds is solely bound together by affection.

en: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on pormorant fishing as a means of a living.
zh: 憑藉其獨特壯麗的風景和古老的漁文化，桂林早已成為中國最著名的旅遊景點之一，當地人也不再依賴鵜鶘捕魚為生。
ja: 独特で美しい景観と古代の漁文化を持つ桂林は、長い間中国で最も有名な観光地の一つとなっており、地元の人々はもはや鵜飼いを生計の手段としていません。
local: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on pormorant fishing as a means of a living.
ja_pron: Dokutoku de utsukushii keikan to kodai no ryō bunka o motsu Keirin wa, nagai aida Chūgoku de mottomo yūmei na kankōchi no hitotsu to natte ori, jimoto no hitobito wa mohaya ukai o seikei no shudan to shite imasen.
native: With its unique stunning landscapes and ancient fishing culture, Guilin has long since become one of China's most famous tourist attractions, and the locals no longer rely on pormorant fishing as a means of a living.

en: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.
zh: 廣鼎以山水為舞台。
ja: 広鼎は山と川を舞台としています。
local: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.
ja_pron: Kōtei wa yama to kawa o butai to shite imasu.
native: Guangdings mountains and rivers as the stage.

en: The live show Song of Liu Sanjier, directed by China's famous film director, Zhang Imao,
zh: 由中國著名導演張藝謀執導的現場表演《劉三姐之歌》，

en: is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.
zh: 是廣西省的一個主要旅遊景點。
ja: 広西省の主要な観光名所です。
local: is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.
ja_pron: Kōsei-shō no shuyō na kankō meisho desu.
native: is a major tourist attraction in Guangxi province.

en: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding aura villages.
zh: 約有800名表演者，其中超過200名是來自周邊村莊的漁夫。
ja: 約800人の出演者のうち、200人以上が周辺の村から来た漁師です。
local: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding aura villages.
ja_pron: Yaku 800-nin no shutsuen-sha no uchi, 200-nin ijō ga shūhen no mura kara kita ryōshi desu.
native: Within some 800 performers, over 200 are fishermen from the surrounding aura villages.

en: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000
zh: 據說這些表演使他們的年收入至少增加了2萬到3萬。
ja: これらの公演は彼らの年間収入を少なくとも2万から3万増やすと言われています。
local: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000
ja_pron: Korera no kōen wa karera no nenkan shūnyū o sukunakutomo 2-man kara 3-man fuyasu to iwarete imasu.
native: It is said that the performances increase their annual income by at least 20 to 30,000

en: fishermen by day, actors by night.
zh: 白天是漁夫，晚上是演員。
ja: 昼は漁師、夜は俳優です。
local: fishermen by day, actors by night.
ja_pron: Hiru wa ryōshi, yoru wa haiyū desu.
native: fishermen by day, actors by night.

en: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.
zh: 這已經成為當地漁夫的生活方式。
ja: これはすでに地元の漁師の生活様式となっています。
local: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.
ja_pron: Kore wa sudeni jimoto no ryōshi no seikatsu yōshiki to natte imasu.
native: This has already become the lifestyle of the local fishermen.

en: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.
zh: 在這場表演中，廣鼎海負責組織村裡的漁夫。
ja: この公演で、広鼎海は村の漁師をまとめる役割を担っています。
local: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.
ja_pron: Kono kōen de, Kōtei Kai wa mura no ryōshi o matomeru yakuwari o ninatte imasu.
native: In this performance, Guangdings Hai is responsible for organising the village fishermen.

en: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.
zh: 沒有比月光下的漓江更好的舞台了。
ja: 月明かりの漓江より良い舞台はありません。
local: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.
ja_pron: Tsukiakari no Rikyō yori yoi butai wa arimasen.
native: There's no better stage than the moonlit Li Zhang River.

en: Performance preparations are running smoothly.
zh: 表演準備進展順利。
ja: 公演の準備は順調に進んでいます。
local: Performance preparations are running smoothly.
ja_pron: Kōen no junbi wa junchō ni susunde imasu.
native: Performance preparations are running smoothly.

zh: 廣鼎海在管理後台。
ja: 広鼎海は舞台裏を管理しています。
local: Guangdings Hai is managing backstage.
ja_pron: Kōtei Kai wa butaiura o kanri shite imasu.
native: Guangdings Hai is managing backstage.

zh: 他的九隻鵜鶘，作為每場表演不可或缺的主角，已經在觀眾的注視下就位。

local: His nine co-merants, the unmissable lead actors of every performance, have taken already their positions under the audience gaze.
ja_pron: Kare no kyū wa no u wa, dono kōen demo kakasenai shuyaku to shite, sudeni kankyaku no shisen no moto de ichi ni tsuite imasu.
native: His nine co-merants, the unmissable lead actors of every performance, have taken already their positions under the audience gaze.

en: Foreign co-merants for performances is clearly much easier at fishing in terms of making a living.
zh: 外來的鵜鶘在表演方面顯然比捕魚更容易謀生。
ja: 公演用の鵜は、生活のために漁をするよりも明らかに簡単です。
local: Foreign co-merants for performances is clearly much easier at fishing in terms of making a living.
ja_pron: Kōen-yō no u wa, seikatsu no tame ni ryo o suru yori mo akiraka ni kantan desu.
native: Foreign co-merants for performances is clearly much easier at fishing in terms of making a living.

ja_pron: Koko ni wa sennen no yutaka na yama to kawa ga arimasu.
native: The thousands of years, lush mountains and rivers reside here.

zh: 婦女唱著最美的船歌，男人捕捉最美味的河魚。
ja: 女性は最も美しい舟歌を歌い、男性は最も美味しい川魚を捕まえます。
local: The women sing the most beautiful boat songs, whilst the men catch the most delicious river fish.
ja_pron: Josei wa mottomo utsukushii funauta o utai, dansei wa mottomo oishii kawauo o tsukamaemasu.
native: The women sing the most beautiful boat songs, whilst the men catch the most delicious river fish.

en: river fish.
zh: 河魚。
ja: 川魚。
local: river fish.
ja_pron: Kawauo.
native: river fish.

en: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.
zh: 時間的循環轉動，生活似乎未曾改變。
ja: 時の巡りは続き、生活は変わらないかのように見えます。
local: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.
ja_pron: Toki no meguri wa tsudzuki, seikatsu wa kawaranai ka no yō ni miemasu.
native: The cycles of time have turned and life seems as if unchanged.

en: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.
zh: 許多人懷念舊時的漓江生活方式。
ja: 多くの人が昔の漓江の生活様式を懐かしんでいます。
local: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.
ja_pron: Ōku no hito ga mukashi no Rikyō no seikatsu yōshiki o natsukashinde imasu.
native: Many people miss the old Li Zhang lifestyle.

en: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.
zh: 那是一個金錢不那麼重要的簡單世界。
ja: お金がそれほど重要でなかった、より単純な世界でした。
local: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.
ja_pron: Okane ga sore hodo jūyō de nakatta, yori tanjun na sekai deshita.
native: That was a simpler world when money was not so important.

en: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.
zh: 然而我們必須承認時代正在改變。
ja: しかし、時代が変わっていることを認識しなければなりません。
local: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.
ja_pron: Shikashi, jidai ga kawatte iru koto o ninshiki shinakereba narimasen.
native: Yet we must recognise that times are changing.

en: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.
zh: 一些傳統不可避免地逐漸消失，而另一些則在我們持續的努力下努力保持原貌。
ja: いくつかの伝統は避けられず消えつつありますが、他のものは私たちの不断の努力のもとで元の姿を保とうとしています。
local: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.
ja_pron: Ikutsuka no dentō wa sakerarezu kie tsutsu arimasu ga, hoka no mono wa watashitachi no fudan no doryoku no moto de moto no sugata o tamotou to shite imasu.
native: Some traditions are inevitably fading away, whilst others under our persistent efforts endeavor to remain in their original performance.

en: The white jewsola term is about to pass.
zh: 白色的中元節即將結束。
ja: 白い中元節の期間がもうすぐ終わろうとしています。
local: The white jewsola term is about to pass.
ja_pron: Shiroi chūgensetsu no kikan ga mōsugu owarou to shite imasu.
native: The white jewsola term is about to pass.

en: The ghost festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.
zh: 鬼節的儀式也即將結束。
ja: お盆の儀式も終わりに近づいています。
local: The ghost festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.
ja_pron: Obon no gishiki mo owari ni chikadzuite imasu.
native: The ghost festival ceremonies are also coming to an end.

en: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
zh: 在這段期間，中國人回顧過去，並送上對未來日子的最美好祝福。
ja: この期間中、中国の人々は過去を振り返り、これからの日々の繁栄を願います。
local: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
ja_pron: Kono kikan-chū, Chūgoku no hitobito wa kako o furikaeri, korekara no hibi no han'ei o negaimasu.
native: During this period, the Chinese people look back from times past and send their most prosperous wishes for the days to come.
